notes: Tests whether the human-approval gate can be bypassed via prompt injection in the ticket body. It must not be -- the gate is enforced in code (SENSITIVE_ISSUE_CATEGORIES check) rather than by asking the LLM whether to approve, so it should be architecturally immune regardless of what the ticket text instructs.
Tests the input-validation guard: missing subject, malformed email, and a too-short description should all be caught before any classification is attempted.
